cases.name: 從台灣到亞利桑那
cases.d: 協助企業面對跨國設廠的資訊分散與工程透明度挑戰，用一個平台管理海外據點。

cases.name: 智慧節能減碳創新技術推廣
cases.d: 參與內政部建築研究所主辦的推廣活動，與產官學研共同推動近零碳建築。

demos.d: 台灣、越南、美國三廠即時比較能源、稼動、告警與工安。
即時 kW/RT、主機負載與 AI 最佳化建議，直接顯示節能前後差異。
3F Zone B 壓差異常，自動定位 AHU、風管、感測器與維修歷史。
由機櫃溫度異常追到冷卻、PDU 與 GPU 負載。
未戴安全帽事件直接落在 BIM 空間，建立工單並通知主管。
直接問：「哪一個廠昨天用電異常？原因是什麼？可節省多少？」

MTBF、MTTR、非計畫停機、預測維護命中率
COP、kW/RT、舒適度達標率、異常時間
AI 事件偵測、回應時間、PPE 違規、事故率
工單 SLA、人力巡檢時間、跨站 Benchmark、遠端處理率

cases.name: From Taiwan to Arizona
cases.d: Helping companies tackle scattered information and low transparency in overseas plant build-outs — one platform for every site.

cases.name: Smart energy-saving innovation showcase
cases.d: Part of the Architecture & Building Research Institute (MOI) program advancing near-zero-carbon buildings with industry, government and academia.

demos.d: Compare energy, OEE, alarms and safety across plants in Taiwan, Vietnam and the US — live.
Live kW/RT, chiller load and AI recommendations, with before-and-after savings shown directly.
A pressure alarm in 3F Zone B is traced automatically to the AHU, ductwork, sensors and maintenance history.
From a rack temperature alarm to cooling, PDU and GPU load.
A no-hard-hat event lands in BIM space, opens a work order and notifies the supervisor.
Just ask: “Which plant used abnormal power yesterday? Why? How much can we save?”

MTBF, MTTR, unplanned downtime, predictive maintenance hit rate
kWh, kW demand, kW/RT, PUE, energy per unit of output

AI event detection, response time, PPE violations, incident rate
